+# Agentic review tools
+
+The agentic engine (Plus and Apex tiers) lets sub-agents explore a repository
+through a fixed set of tools in `internal/hosted/agent`. Every tool is
+read-only. `run_tests` will join this set only with the sandboxed test agent;
+it is deliberately absent until that sandbox exists.
+
+| Tool | Reads | Bound |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `read_file` | One line range at the reviewed head | 400 lines |
+| `search_code` | Embedding and exact-text index | 20 hits |
+| `graph_callers`, `graph_callees` | Symbol graph from a path and symbol name | Two hops, 50 symbols |
+| `git_blame` | Last commit per line in a range | 400 lines |
+| `git_log` | Recent commits to one file | 20 commits |
+| `read_issue` | A Linear or Jira issue linked from the pull request | Linked keys only |
+
+Tool names use underscores rather than `graph.callers` because model
+providers restrict tool names to letters, digits, `_`, and `-`.
+
+## Guarantees
+
+- **Pinned scope.** Every call carries the installation, repository, and full
+  head SHA. A call without them is rejected before any store is read.
+- **Strict arguments.** Arguments are decoded with unknown fields and trailing
+  data rejected, and limited to 4 KiB. Out-of-range values are clamped or
+  rejected, never passed through.
+- **No path escapes.** Paths are normalized and must stay repository-relative.
+- **Linked issues only.** `read_issue` fetches only keys detected on the pull
+  request. Text injected into the diff cannot make a sub-agent read, and
+  then quote, an unrelated ticket from the same tenant.
+- **Bounded output.** Each result is capped at 16 KiB, cut on a UTF-8
+  boundary and marked `[output truncated by px1]`.
+- **Fail closed.** A model is offered only tools whose backing store is
+  configured, and a call to an unconfigured or unknown tool returns an error
+  that can be reported back to the model.
+
+Tool output is repository content. Prompts must present it as untrusted data,
+never as instructions.

explanations.title: Hide unavailable tools
explanations.summary: The model is offered only tools with configured backing stores, so it cannot select tools that are unavailable for a review.

explanations.title: Require a pinned review scope
explanations.summary: Dispatch rejects calls unless they include a positive installation and repository ID and a full lowercase 40-character commit SHA. This prevents tool reads without a pinned tenant and revision.

explanations.title: Reject invalid calls
explanations.summary: Calls with oversized arguments, unknown tool names, or tool-specific validation errors fail before returning tool output.

explanations.title: Bound code search
explanations.summary: Search queries must be 1–200 bytes, and results are capped at 20 even if the backing search returns more.

explanations.title: Scope graph lookups
explanations.summary: Graph lookups resolve the requested symbol in the scoped repository and revision, then query callers or callees with a two-hop, 50-symbol bound. Missing symbols return an explanatory result rather than failing the call.

explanations.title: Bound history reads
explanations.summary: Blame uses the bounded line-range validation, while file history is limited to 20 commits.

explanations.title: Restrict issue reads to linked keys
explanations.summary: Issue reads are allowed only for keys already linked from the pull request, preventing a call from fetching an unrelated issue in the same tenant.

explanations.title: Constrain arguments and paths
explanations.summary: Argument decoding rejects unknown fields and trailing data. File and history ranges are limited to 400 lines, and paths are normalized and rejected if they escape the repository.

explanations.title: Cap tool output
explanations.summary: Tool results are capped at 16 KiB by default, cut at a valid UTF-8 boundary, and marked when truncated.
